title: Proof, not a checkmark: what every VirtualPyTest run leaves behind
description:
A green tick tells you nothing when the screen was wrong. Every VirtualPyTest run leaves evidence you can open: initial and final state, the full execution video, one screenshot per step, the DOM captured at every screen, and per-step pass or fail with timings. Then pass rate and run history across the whole team.

Recorded on a real browser driven by the navigation tree, on the YouTube web app.
